title: Dualizable ordinary derived modules are precisely perfect complexes
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and equip its ordinary unbounded module derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with derived tensor $\otimes_A^L$ and unit $A[0]$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, applied on the one-object site with the identity covering]. An object $Q\in D(A)$ is dualizable, meaning that there exist $Q^\vee\in D(A)$ and maps $Q^\vee\otimes_A^L Q\to A[0]$ and $A[0]\to Q\otimes_A^L Q^\vee$ satisfying both triangle identities, if and only if $Q$ is perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], that is, isomorphic to a bounded complex of finitely generated projective $A$-modules. No Noetherian or nonzero-ring hypothesis is required.
